page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred; below the text a woodcut ornament; at the foot right a catchword. Left edge shows part of the neighbouring page (not transcribed).

main_text.p: rissimé quis inveniatur, qui spectrum viderit; at quòd melancholici, plebeculi, & præsertim sexus fœmineus illis præ aliis terreatur. Uti rarissimum quoque est, spectra à multis simul videri.
main_text.head: VIII.
main_text.p: Quæ omnia ex eis, quæ jam particulariùs de potentia Geniorum malorum in corpora dicemus clariùs cognoscentur.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament below the text, not transcribed. The catchword "EXER-" is printed at the lower right. The first line's word "spectrum" and "spectra" are printed with long s. Several letters in the first lines are damaged ("ii.veniatur", "spe ctrum" with a gap); readings are as best seen.
